submit_job: submit a new job with task definitions and concurrency limit to the JobManager actor
get_job_status: get the status and progress of a job including task counts and active tasks
get_job_results: get the results for all tasks within a completed or running job
delete_job: delete a job by ID and cancel any running Ray tasks associated with it
stop_job_manager: gracefully shut down the JobManager monitor thread and cancel remaining running tasks
